title: Government's Response to Recent Academic Papers on Social Mobility
what_it_is: Government's Response to Recent Academic Papers on Social Mobility

sections.label: Nature social capital papers review
sections.summary: Asked whether the Minister reviewed two Nature papers and how the Ministry factored their findings into social mobility policy-making.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) whether he has reviewed the papers "Social capital I: measurement and associations with economic mobility" and "Social capital II: determinants of economic connectedness" published in Nature on 1 August 2022; and (b) how has the Ministry factored the findings of these papers into the Ministry's policy-making on social mobility.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: If the Member has in mind any specific propositions from the cited papers that he feels is relevant in our policy context, he may wish to articulate them, so that his question can be addressed.
